name: Jeeter | 1g Liquid Diamond Disposable | Guava Burst
description:
Meet Guava Burst - the chill companion. With its tropical aroma and smooth flavor, it's like a mini vacation in every puff.

This hybrid strain is perfect for unwinding or getting those creative juices flowing, offering relaxed vibes and uplifting highs. Take a puff and let the good times roll!

Ultra clean. Ultra potent. Ultra smooth. Built for our most refined extract, this AIO is made for Liquid Diamonds. With lighter viscosity and higher potency, the hardware is engineered to preserve clarity and deliver smooth, powerful hits without clogging or flooding.
